name: Natural Materials
summary: In Camp Mojache, Natural Materials are needed by Witch Doctor Uzer'i for an endeavor. The materials come from treants, mountain giants, faerie dragons, owlbeasts and hippogryphs, alongside the other trials.

sections.title: Gathering for the Witch Doctor
sections.body: After you return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i, another list of materials awaits alongside the other trials. Bring two splintered logs from a Feralas treant. Mountain giants and faerie dragons westward carry six pieces of encrusted minerals. Owlbeasts in the Hinterlands or hippogryphs in Feralas provide twenty pieces of resilient sinew. Any of these creatures can yield the forty metallic fragments needed.

sections.title: Uzer'i's Verdict
sections.body: Witch Doctor Uzer'i is pleased when you bring back the materials. Joined with the muisek, they should bring the results he has wanted.

faq.answer: Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Camp Mojache requests them.

faq.q: What creatures hold the splintered logs?
faq.answer: A Feralas treant provides the two splintered logs you need.

faq.q: Where can encrusted minerals be gathered?
faq.answer: Mountain giants and faerie dragons westward carry the six encrusted minerals you need.

faq.q: Which beasts provide the resilient sinew?
faq.answer: Owlbeasts in the Hinterlands or hippogryphs in Feralas provide the twenty pieces of resilient sinew you need.

faq.q: Where do metallic fragments come from?
faq.answer: The forty metallic fragments can come from treants, mountain giants, faerie dragons, owlbeasts or hippogryphs.
This request follows Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i.
